name: telemetry-export-net-k8s-git-live
description: A two-leg program: a network value leg works out the smallest aligned range covering the telemetry-exporter addresses on ceos1 and ceos2; a Kubernetes change leg adds a NetworkPolicy in trading admitting only that range to the telemetry receiver on TCP 4317 and 4318.

interdependency.value: the exporter range: one aligned IPv4 prefix
